entities.summary: Marcos Aurelio Mateo Lora is a Dominican right-handed former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Chicago Cubs and San Diego Padres, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hanshin Tigers.
